chunks: That We may show you of Our greater signs.
ai.seo_question: What are the greater signs (Ayat al-Kubra) mentioned in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Prophet's spiritual elevation and the revelation of divine realities, with some scholars connecting 'Ayat al-Kubra' to the event of Mi'raj or the ultimate sign of the Mahdi. It underscores the tangible confirmation of prophethood through major miracles, reinforcing the believer's trust in Allah's power to manifest truth in the visible world.
